sort_imports_in_all_inits: sort the _import_structure imports in all __init__.py files under src/transformers
sort_imports: sort the _import_structure imports in a single __init__.py file
sort_objects: sort a list of objects following isort rules with uppercase constants first then classes then functions
sort_objects_in_import: sort the imports within a single _import_structure import statement
split_code_in_indented_blocks: split python code into its indented blocks starting at a given indent level
